## Projects

- [Sama4](https://www.sama4.online/): News that explains itself, right beside the story.
- [AI operator release gate](https://evosdemo.vercel.app): An AI agent earns trust step by step, and loses it fast.
- [Health-first voice onboarding](https://eatopia-demo.vercel.app): Sign-up rebuilt around Apple Health and your voice.
- [Agentic Adjudication](https://github.com/juyal-devashish/Agentic-Adjudication): Agents prepare trial safety cases; people make every call.
- [Sequential watermark detection](https://juyal-devashish.github.io/LLM-Sequential-Watermarking/): Spotting AI-written text with far less compute.
- [MichiganSLM](https://github.com/juyal-devashish/umichslm-walkthrough): Experiments behind Michigan’s first small language model.
- [Multi-stage distillation](https://github.com/juyal-devashish/ELI500Model-Sequential-Distillation): Shrinking a large model into small ones, step by step.
